preconditions.description: The number of employees n is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n for i in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Employee numbers are unique and range from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(p == -1 or (1 <= p <= n and p != i) for i, p in enumerate(p_list, start=1))
preconditions.description: Each employee's immediate manager p_i is either -1 (no manager) or a valid employee number different from their own.

preconditions.expression: not any(i in get_superiors(i, p_list) for i in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: There are no managerial cycles, where an employee is a superior of their own immediate manager.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of groups such that no group contains an employee and their superior.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= i <= n for i in range(1, n + 1))
invariants.description: Employee numbers remain fixed and valid throughout.
